original_target.title: Unbounded first Steklov multiplicity with fixed boundary count
original_target.outcome: Claim: affirmative unbounded first Steklov multiplicity

scope_comparison: Fix b=1 and prescribe a1=...=aN=1 with next eigenvalue>2. TheoremA claims a smooth metric on a connected orientable surface of sufficiently large genus with those exact first N positive ordinary Steklov eigenvalues. Thus first multiplicity equals N with fixed boundary count. Genus may grow as permitted; length rescaling preserves multiplicity. The final theorem absorbs boundary weights into a smooth conformal metric and has no nonconstant interior conductivity.
